title: k3s App Builder Platform
one_liner: A self-contained platform for deploying apps with plain language and Claude, running entirely within k3s on a single EC2 instance.
what_it_is: A local-first application development and deployment platform that allows users to describe an app in natural language, have Claude generate the code, build it into a container, and deploy it to a preview or production environment on a single-node Kubernetes cluster. It eliminates external dependencies by using a local Docker registry, nip.io for DNS, and Traefik for ingress routing.
how_its_built: The platform is built with Python (FastAPI) for the backend logic, utilizing the Anthropic SDK for code generation. It orchestrates infrastructure via subprocess calls to docker and kubectl. The frontend is a web UI that interacts with the backend API. Infrastructure consists of k3s (Kubernetes), Traefik (Ingress Controller), and a local Docker Registry, all running on a single Ubuntu EC2 instance.
how_to_apply: Use this project as a prototype for internal developer platforms (IDPs), educational tools for teaching Kubernetes, or lightweight staging environments where cost and complexity must be minimized. It demonstrates how to isolate applications using Kubernetes namespaces, ResourceQuotas, and NetworkPolicies without cloud-managed services.
quickstart:
git clone https://github.com/davidbmar/2026-FEB-21-K3-App-Builder-Claude-proto
cd 2026-FEB-21-K3-App-Builder-Claude-proto
chmod +x scripts/*.sh
./scripts/install-k3s.sh
./scripts/setup-registry.sh
export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-...
./scripts/bootstrap-cluster.sh
features: Natural language app generation using Claude Opus
Live code streaming and preview before deployment
Automated Docker build and push to local registry
Isolated Kubernetes namespaces per app with resource quotas
One-click promotion from Preview to Production with rolling updates
Instant rollback capability using previous image tags

flowchart TD
    User[User Browser] -->|HTTP Request| NipIO[nip.io DNS]

    subgraph Host OS
        Docker[Docker Daemon]
        Registry[Local Docker Registry :5050]
    end
    subgraph k3s Cluster
        Traefik[Traefik Ingress Controller]
        BuilderNS[Namespace: builder-system]
        AppNS[Namespace: app-{name}]
        
        BuilderUI[Builder UI Pod] -->|Exec| Docker
        BuilderUI -->|kubectl| K8sAPI[k3s API Server]
        
        Traefik -->|Route| BuilderUI
        Traefik -->|Route| AppPreview[Preview Deployment]
        Traefik -->|Route| AppProd[Production Deployment]
        
        AppPreview -->|Pull Image| Registry
        AppProd -->|Pull Image| Registry
    end
    Docker -->|Push Image| Registry
    K8sAPI -->|Manage| AppPreview
    K8sAPI -->|Manage| AppProd
diagram_sequence:
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant UI as Builder UI
    participant Claude as Claude API
    participant Docker as Docker Daemon
    participant Reg as Local Registry
    participant K8s as k3s Cluster

    User->>UI: Describe App & Click Generate
    UI->>Claude: Stream Prompt with Template
    Claude-->>UI: Stream Code Files
    UI->>User: Display Generated Code
    
    User->>UI: Click Build & Deploy Preview
    UI->>Docker: docker build .
    Docker->>Reg: Push image:tag
    UI->>K8s: kubectl apply (Preview Deployment)
    K8s->>Reg: Pull image:tag
    K8s-->>UI: Deployment Ready
    UI->>User: Show Preview URL
    
    User->>UI: Click Publish to Production
    UI->>K8s: kubectl set image (Prod Deployment)
    K8s->>Reg: Pull image:tag
    K8s-->>UI: Rolling Update Complete
